cases.reason: The task identifies what to add and where, and gives criteria a reviewer can check for button placement, exported rows, column order, and date filtering.

The task specifies a 30-minute expiration for password reset links on the Quillmoor members site and gives checkable criteria for what happens when members open links within 30 minutes or at 31 minutes.
The task specifies a print stylesheet for Larkspur Kitchen’s recipe pages, identifies what printed recipes must show and hide, and gives a checkable one-page A4 PDF test using the Barley Soup recipe.
The task names the backup script and log destination, specifies the fields the operator needs, and gives checkable criteria for both successful runs and archive write failures.
The task specifies where to show the event’s time zone abbreviation in Hollowbrook’s guest invitations and gives checkable expected results for Berlin and New York events.

The task names the Driftwood help centre search results page, specifies the empty-state message and contact link, and gives a test query that lets a reviewer verify both while checking that the search box stays at the top.
The task names Fernhollow’s public forecast API and the two headers its callers need, and the criteria let a reviewer verify the 600-call limit and the one-call decrease in the remaining count.
The task specifies the guide’s repository path, audience, and required content, and a reviewer can check that the file exists, covers the listed information, and fits on one printed page.
The task specifies which heading to change on the Thimblevane shop’s About page and gives the exact wording a reviewer can verify.

The task specifies raising the Quillmoor members site's idle sign-out timeout from 15 to 60 minutes for members reading long articles and checks that a member remains signed in after 45 minutes of inactivity.
The task identifies the map image on the Larkspur Kitchen blog’s Contact page, specifies the exact alt text for screen reader users, and gives a reviewer a concrete criterion to verify.
The task identifies the Hollowbrook RSVP form’s Submit button, explains the change is for guests, and provides a checkable criterion that the button reads “Send my reply.”
The task identifies the Driftwood help centre but leaves both the requested change and the criteria for judging improvement undefined.
The task leaves both the required changes to the Thimblevane shop and the standard for verifying them undefined.
The task identifies the reports and their users and gives a checkable criterion, but it leaves the requested change unspecified.
The task identifies the Quillmoor sign-up flow and gives a checkable criterion, but it leaves open what about the flow should change.
The task specifies a larger photo of the newest recipe at the top of the blog’s home page, but none of the acceptance criteria verifies that change or defines a measurable outcome.
The task identifies the Orders page and its users, but none of the acceptance criteria defines an observable result a reviewer can verify.
The task identifies the Hollowbrook RSVP form and calls for plain-language errors, but none of its criteria specifies an observable requirement for the revised messages.
The task identifies the sign-up box, its location, and its audience, but none of the acceptance criteria specifies an observable result or a standard a reviewer can check.
The task names the Fernhollow weather app but leaves the change unspecified, and neither criterion identifies an observable result a reviewer can verify.
